aiStories.title: 本·阿弗莱克是个“AI极客”，网友们都惊叹不已
aiStories.originalTitle: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
aiStories.snippet: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.
aiStories.fullContent:
They cast the wrong lead in “Good Will Hunting,” apparently, because it’s Ben Affleck who is the secret genius, as it turns out. The actor who earlier this year sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix for a reported $587 million has gone viral this week for demonstrating his understanding of AI technology, neural networks, machine learning, and the like, across multiple video clips of his recent interviews.

He can even write a little Python, he says.

The movie star delved into his interest in technology most recently on an episode of GQ’s “One More Question” series this week, where he humbly started with “I’ve always been kind of into computers since I was young,” before nerding out on the development of AI as it relates to filmmaking, while using AI terminology like machine learning, neural networks, transformers, tensors, GPUs, inference, and more.

In a clip that’s making the rounds, Affleck explains to the impressed interviewer, Zach Baron, that he got into the space when analog film moved to digital. As he spoke, he kept defining terms so the interviewer could understand what he was talking about.

“I became more interested in that aspect of it, and the visual effects workflow for many years has included machine learning,” Affleck began. “So I can write, like, pretty shitty Python scripts and stuff like that. Because with convolutional neural networks — which were the sort of precursors to what the transformer can do — which is just much more computation simultaneously — you would do things like, look at what’s called a tensor — which is just the numerical translation of a visual image, in numbers like the batch number, the frame number, the red, green, and blue values of each pixel in each frame, and how many? It’s just that simple, right?”

No, Ben Affleck, it is not just that simple, which is why this video is going viral.

The actor then went into how neural networks were used to identify patterns and do edge detection or feature extraction, which he described as “identifying patterns enough to know — like this is where the window ledge is, so we can more easily take the green screen image out and replace it with something.”

He also admitted he used his status as a Hollywood star to get a peek at emerging AI technology, at times. OpenAI was among those he visited, Affleck said in a separate clip, which ultimately led him to understand how he could get more directly involved in the AI space.

As the interviewer continued, Affleck explained how AI can help with filmmaking while not replacing it, leading to the development and sale of his own startup in this space. (He claims the $587 million figure is “not right,” noting that he didn’t own the whole company.)

“I gambled on this notion that in order to do this in an ethical way and in a way that could take this technology and actually make it work hand in glove with artists in this community where there are very fixed, long-standing relationships around likeness and so forth, we had to create our own dataset,” he said. “So I raised the money. I shot for about eight months with a lot of cameras and a lot of equipment, and created a dataset that would serve as late-stage training for open models to do discrete tasks, sort of where the training code, the inference code, were related to one another and geared toward actual specific tasks that would generate value,” Affleck said.

In a separate clip, also going viral, Affleck spoke to Bloomberg’s Lucas Shaw at the Screentime 2026 conference in LA, where he talked about how he fine-tuned AI models by taking open source models, unfreezing the weights, then teaching them to meet certain cinematic standards. In the process, the filmmaker retains their proprietary work, while benefiting from the learning they create by training their own unique model for the movie they’re making.

Ben Affleck (Hollywood star & Artists Equity CEO) talks about how he fine-tunes open video models by unfreezing weights and trained only the last cinematic layer so a film crew can hit real production standards.for context, Ben Affleck founded InterPositive in 2022, a 16-person… pic.twitter.com/xIOvD0xMyt

The actor used the technique himself in his movie “Animals,” where AI aided in the post-production process.

At one point, he also weighed in on the concerns around AI and its world-ending potential. His worries, however, were much more rational.

“When I worry about AI, I worry about my kids in school. I worry about the 30% rise in the number of A’s given out at colleges over the last three years. I worry about learned helplessness. I worry about responsible use. I don’t worry about Skynet, and I don’t think that it’s going to take over [the movie] business in any meaningful way. I think it’s going to be additive,” Affleck said.

aiStories.fullTranslation:
显然，《心灵捕手》选错了主演，因为事实证明，真正的隐藏天才是本·阿弗莱克。今年早些时候，这位演员将自己的人工智能电影制作初创公司以据称5.87亿美元的价格出售给了Netflix。本周，他在多段近期采访视频中展示了自己对人工智能技术、神经网络、机器学习等领域的理解，迅速走红网络。

他说，自己甚至还会写一点Python代码。

本周，这位电影明星在GQ的《One More Question》系列节目中谈到了自己对科技的兴趣。他谦逊地以“我从小就对电脑有点兴趣”开场，随后开始兴致勃勃地讲述人工智能的发展及其与电影制作的关系，并使用了机器学习、神经网络、变换器、张量、GPU、推理等一系列人工智能术语。

在一段广为流传的视频中，面对印象深刻的采访者扎克·巴伦，阿弗莱克解释说，当模拟胶片转向数字化时，他开始涉足这一领域。在讲述过程中，他不断解释相关术语，以便采访者理解他的意思。

阿弗莱克说：“我对其中那一部分越来越感兴趣，而多年来，视觉特效工作流程一直包含机器学习。所以，我可以写一些——比如说——相当糟糕的Python脚本之类的东西。因为卷积神经网络——它们可以算是变换器所能实现功能的先驱，而变换器能够同时进行更多计算——你可以做这样的事情：查看所谓的张量，也就是把一幅视觉图像转化为数字，比如批次编号、帧编号，以及每一帧中每个像素的红、绿、蓝数值，还有数量……事情就是这么简单，对吧？”

不，本·阿弗莱克，事情并没有这么简单，这正是这段视频走红的原因。

随后，这位演员讲解了神经网络如何用于识别模式、进行边缘检测或特征提取。他将其描述为：“进行足够程度的模式识别，从而知道——比如这里就是窗台所在的位置，这样我们就能更容易地把绿幕图像抠出来，再替换成其他内容。”

他还承认，自己有时会利用好莱坞明星的身份，去了解新兴的人工智能技术。阿弗莱克说，他曾访问过OpenAI等公司；这最终让他明白，自己可以更直接地参与人工智能领域。

随着采访继续，阿弗莱克解释了人工智能如何在不取代电影制作的情况下为其提供帮助，这也促成了他在该领域创办并出售自己的初创公司。（他声称5.87亿美元这一数字“不准确”，并指出自己并不拥有整家公司。）

阿弗莱克说：“我押注于这样一个想法：为了以合乎伦理的方式完成这件事，也为了让这项技术真正能够与这个行业的艺术家密切协作——在这个行业里，围绕肖像权等问题存在非常明确且长期存在的关系——我们必须创建自己的数据集。因此，我筹集了资金，用大量摄像机和设备拍摄了大约八个月，创建了一个数据集，用于对开放模型进行后期阶段的训练，以完成具体任务。也就是说，训练代码和推理代码彼此关联，并且都面向能够创造价值的实际特定任务。”

在另一段同样走红的视频中，阿弗莱克在洛杉矶举行的Screentime 2026大会上接受彭博社记者卢卡斯·肖采访，谈到了自己如何微调人工智能模型：先使用开源模型，解冻其权重，然后训练它们达到特定的电影制作标准。在这一过程中，电影制作人可以保留自己的专有成果，同时从训练过程中产生的学习成果中获益，为正在制作的电影训练出独特模型。

本·阿弗莱克（好莱坞明星兼Artists Equity首席执行官）谈论了自己如何通过解冻权重来微调开放视频模型，并只训练最后的电影制作层，以便电影摄制团队达到真正的制作标准。作为背景资料，本·阿弗莱克于2022年创办了InterPositive，这是一家拥有16名员工的…… pic.twitter.com/xIOvD0xMyt

这位演员本人就在电影《动物们》中使用了这一技术，让人工智能协助完成后期制作。

他还曾谈到围绕人工智能及其可能毁灭世界的潜在风险的担忧。不过，他的担忧要理性得多。

阿弗莱克说：“当我担心人工智能时，我担心的是我的孩子在学校的情况。我担心过去三年大学里获得A的学生人数增加了30%。我担心习得性无助。我担心负责任地使用人工智能。我不担心‘天网’，也不认为它会以任何有意义的方式接管（电影）行业。我认为它会起到增益作用。”

trendStories.fullContent:
Some change in our lifestyles and environments over a generation has caused this increased risk. What, exactly, is a mystery

Prof Devi Sridhar is chair of global public health at the University of Edinburgh

In the field of global health, we often talk about each generation living longer and healthier lives than their parents. We’ve seen this in the gains in life expectancy, the sharp decrease in child mortality and in the near elimination of many vaccine-preventable diseases. But since the turn of the century this progress has stalled, and in some cases several health metrics have gone backwards.

Take cancer, which was long thought to be a disease linked to old age. While most cancers do indeed still occur in elderly people, a new report highlights that a number of cancers are increasing in people who are under 50 , often referred to as “early onset cancer”. The report, undertaken by the World Cancer Research Fund, looked at data from 12 different cancer types in England, the US and the Netherlands over the past 20 years. What they found isn’t pretty.

Prof Devi Sridhar is chair of global public health at the University of Edinburgh
trendStories.fullTranslation:
一代人之间我们的生活方式和环境所发生的一些变化导致了这种风险增加。而具体原因，至今仍是一个谜。
德维·斯里达尔教授系爱丁堡大学全球公共卫生讲席教授。
在全球卫生领域，我们经常谈论每一代人都比上一代人活得更长寿、更健康。我们在预期寿命的增长、儿童死亡率的大幅下降以及许多可通过疫苗预防的疾病几乎被消灭中看到了这一点。然而，自世纪之交以来，这种进步已经停滞，在某些情况下，若干健康指标甚至出现倒退。
以癌症为例，长期以来它一直被认为是一种与衰老相关的疾病。尽管大多数癌症确实仍然发生在老年人身上，但一份新报告强调，在50岁以下人群中，多种癌症的发病率正在上升，这通常被称为“早发性癌症”。该报告由世界癌症研究基金会（World Cancer Research Fund）发起，研究了过去20年间英格兰、美国和荷兰的12种不同癌症类型的数据。他们的发现并不乐观。

trendStories.title: 减少 C 语言中的未定义行为
trendStories.originalTitle: Reducing undefined behavior in the C language
trendStories.fullContent:
Why bother with C in 2026? It is, he said, still a great language. C is portable, stable over the long term, offers fast compilation, and the resulting binary code is fast. "What you see is what you get"; it is easy to look at C code and have some idea of what the computer will actually do. There are a lot of tools for working with the language, and C gets out of the way when necessary.

C does have a long history, and that affects the language as we see it today, he said. The C89 standard had to cope with a wide variety of hardware, including machines with signed-magnitude or one's-complement integer representations, segmented memory, exotic pointer representations, and surprising sizes for types. Some Honeywell machines, for example, had nine-bit bytes. That greatly complicated the task of writing a standard that would enable the writing of portable code.

The approach that was taken was to define the semantics of the language in terms of an abstract machine. All operations are to be executed as if they had run on that abstract machine, which may not exactly match the actual hardware. The observable behavior of the program must be what the abstract machine would have done. The "observable" part matters: access to volatile variables, being defined as observable, must happen exactly according to the abstract machine; everything else just has to produce the same eventual result.

The standard gives a lot of freedom to compiler implementers; only the observable behavior has to be preserved. There are many aspects of that behavior that are either undefined or implementation-defined. These are not observable behavior, and thus do not constrain what compiler implementers can do. There are, of course, other specifications that can constrain compiler developers where the C standard does not; these include ABI requirements, standards like POSIX, or the need for backward compatibility.

Undefined behavior comes about when a program does something that is either not portable or not defined by the standard at all. In such cases, the C89 standard states that it "imposes no requirements" on the implementation. Undefined behavior exists for a number of reasons. It allows implementations to support extensions, manage interactions with hardware-based safety mechanisms, and perform aggressive optimization, all while allowing difficult-to-detect errors to be ignored. It explicitly gives the compiler the right to ignore whole classes of hard-to-detect errors.

The problem, Uecker said, is that the standard allows a compiler to do anything in response to undefined behavior, up to the point of invoking nasal demons. If a program contains any undefined behavior at all, according to compiler writers, then it has no expected semantics. The C++23 standard goes further to explicitly state that the standard imposes no requirements for these programs. That has led to widespread disagreements between developers about what can be expected from the language.

For example, if you zero an entire structure (perhaps with a call to memset()), then write to specific fields, what will happen if you read from any padding bytes in that structure? Might they contain security-relevant data? A 2015 survey showed that there was no consensus on what should happen in that case. Or consider this simple code:

If b is zero, then the return statement is a division by zero, which is undefined behavior. In this case, is the compiler entitled to omit the test entirely and just execute x = 42? After all, the b = 0 case has no expected semantics, and can thus be ignored. There are compilers that will do exactly that. In the undefined-behavior case, the store to x is not observable behavior. But now consider this case:

This might seem to be the same situation, with the compiler being entitled to remove the test and just pass 42 to g(), and some compilers have treated that way — but that compiler behavior was a bug. Imagine a definition of g() that calls exit() if b is zero. In that case, the division will never happen and the program's behavior is not undefined. So eliding the test and simply passing 42 to g() is incorrect.

One more interesting case:

The question here is: can the compiler hoist the final division operation above assignment to x? If there are no semantics associated with the b = 0 case, then there is no change in observable behavior. This, too, is something compilers have done, but the C23 standard added a "no time travel" stipulation to disallow it. In C++, instead, hoisting must be explicitly prevented by inserting a call to std::observable_checkpoint().

Time-travel bugs should eventually go away, but there are a lot of other situations where, even if the standard is clear, compiler writers often disagree. These include reading of uninitialized variables (which is almost always defined), and equality comparisons of pointers, which is always defined, but is also miscompiled by both Clang and GCC.

To try to address all of these problems and more, the C committee runs three study groups focused specifically on the memory object model, memory safety, and undefined behavior. There are currently about 100 instances of undefined behavior in the C standard, but the in-progress C2y draft has removed 45 of them. The situation is indeed getting better.

There is an increasingly rich set of tools aimed at finding issues: compiler warnings, static analyzers, sanitizers, LLM-based tools, formal verification, and more. The number of situations where a compiler will emit a warning where possible undefined behavior is detected is growing; recent examples include better warnings for integer overflows and potential use-after-free situations. Static analyzers are available as standalone tools, but are also increasingly being built into the compilers themselves; GCC can now warn about a number of potential buffer-overflow situations, for example. Sanitizers work by inserting run-time checks; they can catch a lot of undefined behavior and, in trapping mode, be used for hardening as well.

Memory safety has never been one of C's strong points, but Uecker wanted to make the point that it can be improved. That problem breaks down into three sub-problems: type safety, spatial memory safety, and temporal memory safety.

C, he said, has a strong type system, and the remaining problems are fixable. Tagless unions, for example, can create type confusion, but the compiler can enforce types with some additional annotations. New diagnostics can catch unsafe casts from void. Type checking across translation units is traditionally not a huge problem in C, since header files are used to ensure consistent types, but the situation could be improved with a link-time checker.

Spatial memory safety — bounds checking — is a partially solved problem; the compilers can perform array-bounds checking in many situations now. In some cases, some code changes are needed to fully benefit from this checking. Use of the counted_by attribute can enable checking for flexible array members, for example.

Temporal memory safety — avoiding use-after-free bugs and the like — is harder, Uecker said, and Rust definitely has an advantage there. Still, better temporal memory-safety enforcement is possible. Architectures like CHERI can help here is well. Fil-C can find a lot of temporal-safety bugs.

Can all of these tools and language changes get us to full memory safety? Completely solving the problem will require either expensive run-time checking or formal verification, he said. In the near future, the most complete results will be had with the combination of a restricted language and formal verification tools.

Overall, he concluded, C is still a living language and is still improving. The C23 standard removed a number of problematic features, including old-style (K&R) function definitions, support for sign-magnitude and one's-complement machines, and trigraphs. It added bit-precise integer types, checked integer operations, and more. C2y will go further, adding case ranges, named for loops, the _Countof() macro to determine array lengths, and a lot of "demon removal". It will not achieve full memory safety for C, but that is an eventual possibility, and will become more practical over time. He ended by encouraging interested people to participate in the working groups.

The video and slides from this talk are available.

[Thanks to the Linux Foundation, LWN's travel sponsor, for supporting my travel for this event.]

trendStories.fullTranslation:
为什么在 2026 年还要关注 C 语言？他说，它仍然是一门优秀的语言。C 语言具备可移植性，长期保持稳定，编译速度极快，生成的二进制代码执行效率也很高。“所见即所得”；看着 C 代码，你很容易就能明白计算机实际会执行什么操作。围绕这门语言有大量成熟的工具，而且在必要时 C 语言也不会横加干涉。

他说，C 语言确实历史悠久，而这影响了它如今的面貌。C89 标准必须应对种类繁多的硬件，包括采用原码或反码整数表示的机器、分段内存、奇特的指针表示方式以及令人意想不到的类型大小。例如，某些霍尼韦尔（Honeywell）机器采用 9 位字节。这使得制定一个能够编写可移植代码的标准变得异常复杂。

当时采取的做法是根据“抽象机”来定义该语言的语义。所有操作都应当像是在那台抽象机上运行一样来执行，而这台抽象机可能与实际硬件并不完全吻合。程序的可观察行为（observable behavior）必须符合抽象机的行为方式。“可观察”这一部分至关重要：对 volatile 变量的访问被定义为可观察的，必须严格按照抽象机进行；而其他所有操作只要能产生相同的最终结果即可。

该标准赋予了编译器实现者极大的自由度；只需保留可观察行为即可。而该行为中有许多方面要么是未定义的（undefined），要么是由实现定义的（implementation-defined）。这些都不属于可观察行为，因此不会限制编译器实现者可以做什么。当然，在 C 标准未作限制的地方，还有其他规范可以约束编译器开发者；这些规范包括 ABI 要求、POSIX 等标准，或者向后兼容性的需要。

当程序执行了不可移植或标准根本未作定义的操作时，就会出现未定义行为（undefined behavior）。在这种情况下，C89 标准规定它对实现“不提出任何要求”。未定义行为的存在有多种原因：它允许实现支持扩展，处理与基于硬件的安全机制之间的交互，并执行激进的优化，同时允许忽略难以检测的错误。它明确赋予了编译器忽略整类难以检测错误的权利。

Uecker 表示，问题在于标准允许编译器对未定义行为做出任何反应，甚至达到“鼻中飞出恶魔（invoking nasal demons）”的荒谬地步。在编译器编写者看来，如果一个程序包含任何未定义行为，那么它就没有任何预期的语义。C++23 标准更进一步，明确规定标准对此类程序不施加任何要求。这导致开发者之间对于这门语言到底能提供何种预期产生了广泛的分歧。

例如，如果你将整个结构体清零（比如调用 memset()），然后向特定字段写入数据，那么如果你从该结构体的任何填充字节（padding bytes）中读取数据，会发生什么？它们是否可能包含与安全相关的数据？2015 年的一项调查显示，在这种情况下应该发生什么并未达成共识。或者考虑下面这段简单的代码：

如果 b 为零，那么 return 语句就是一个除以零的操作，属于未定义行为。在这种情况下，编译器是否有权完全省略检查并直接执行 x = 42？毕竟，b = 0 的情况没有任何预期语义，因此可以被忽略。确实有些编译器会这么做。在未定义行为的情况下，向 x 存储值并不算可观察行为。但现在再考虑以下情况：

这看起来似乎是同样的情况，编译器有权移除检查并直接向 g() 传递 42，而且有些编译器也确实是这样处理的——但编译器的这种行为是一个 bug。设想一下 g() 的定义是如果 b 为零就调用 exit()。在这种情况下，除法永远不会发生，程序的行为也不是未定义的。因此，略过检查并简单地向 g() 传递 42 是不正确的。

还有一个有趣的案例：

这里的问题在于：编译器能否将最后的除法操作提升（hoist）到对 x 的赋值之前？如果与 b = 0 的情况相关联没有任何语义，那么可观察行为就不会发生改变。这也是编译器曾经做过的事情，但 C23 标准添加了“禁止时间旅行（no time travel）”规定以杜绝此类行为。相比之下，在 C++ 中，必须通过显式插入对 std::observable_checkpoint() 的调用来阻止这种提升。

“时间旅行”类 bug 最终应该会消失，但在许多其他情况下，即使标准很明确，编译器编写者也往往存在分歧。这些情况包括读取未初始化的变量（这几乎总是有定义的），以及指针的相等性比较（这始终是有定义的，但 Clang 和 GCC 都曾对其进行过错误编译）。

为了尝试解决所有这些乃至更多问题，C 语言委员会设立了三个专门针对内存对象模型、内存安全和未定义行为的研究小组。目前 C 标准中大约有 100 处未定义行为，但正在推进中的 C2y 草案已经移除了其中的 45 处。情况确实正在好转。

用于发现问题的工具库正变得越来越丰富：编译器警告、静态分析器、Sanitizer、基于大语言模型的工具、形式化验证等。当检测到潜在的未定义行为时，编译器发出警告的场景正在不断增加；最近的例子包括针对整数溢出和潜在的释放后使用（use-after-free）场景提供了更好的警告。静态分析器不仅可以作为独立工具使用，也越来越多地被直接内置到编译器本身中；例如，GCC 现在可以针对许多潜在的缓冲区溢出情况发出警告。Sanitizer 则通过插入运行时检查来工作；它们可以捕获大量的未定义行为，并在陷阱模式（trapping mode）下用于安全加固。

内存安全从来都不是 C 语言的强项，但 Uecker 想强调的是，它是可以改进的。该问题可拆解为三个子问题：类型安全、空间内存安全和时间内存安全。

他说，C 语言拥有强大的类型系统，剩下的问题是可以修复的。例如，无标签联合体（tagless unions）可能会导致类型混淆，但编译器可以通过一些额外的注解来强制实施类型检查。新的诊断工具可以捕获从 void 进行的不安全类型转换。跨翻译单元的类型检查在传统上对 C 语言来说并不是大问题，因为头文件被用来确保类型一致，但通过链接时检查器，这种情况还可以得到进一步改善。

空间内存安全——即边界检查——是一个已被部分解决的问题；编译器目前已能在许多场景下执行数组边界检查。在某些情况下，需要进行一些代码改动才能充分发挥此类检查的作用。例如，使用 counted_by 属性可以实现对柔性数组（flexible array members）成员的检查。

Uecker 表示，时间内存安全——即避免释放后使用（use-after-free）及类似漏洞——难度更大，而 Rust 在这方面无疑具备优势。尽管如此，实现更完善的时间内存安全强制保障仍然是可能的。像 CHERI 这样的架构在这方面也能提供帮助。Fil-C 则能够发现大量时间安全漏洞。

所有这些工具和语言层面的改进能否让我们达成完全的内存安全？他表示，彻底解决这一问题要么需要代价高昂的运行时检查，要么需要形式化验证。在不久的将来，最完备的成效将来自于受限语言与形式化验证工具的结合。

总的来说，他总结道，C 语言仍然是一门充满活力的语言，并且仍在持续演进。C23 标准移除了诸多存在问题的特性，包括旧式（K&R）函数定义、对原码（sign-magnitude）和反码（one's-complement）机器的支持，以及三字符序列（trigraphs）。它还增加了精确位宽整数类型、带检查的整数运算等。C2y 将走得更远，增加 case 范围匹配、具名 for 循环、用于确定数组长度的 _Countof() 宏，以及大量的“去心魔”（demon removal）工作。它不会让 C 语言实现完全的内存安全，但这终究是一种可能性，并且随着时间的推移会变得越来越切合实际。在演讲的最后，他鼓励有兴趣的人士积极参与工作组。

本次演讲的视频和演示幻灯片现已发布。

[感谢 LWN 的差旅赞助商 Linux 基金会资助我参加本次活动的行程。]

注：今后您可以通过登录 LWN 账号来跳过此步骤。

trendStories.title: 要闻：感谢 227 位贡献者、817 个拉取请求、社区代码审查者以及我们慷慨的资助者，我们很高兴地宣布 Bevy 0.
trendStories.fullContent:
Thanks to 227 contributors, 817 pull requests, community reviewers, and our generous donors, we're happy to announce the Bevy 0.20 release on crates.io!

For those who don't know, Bevy is a refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust. You can check out our Quick Start Guide to try it today. It's free and open source forever! You can grab the full source code on GitHub. Check out Bevy Assets for a collection of community-developed plugins, games, and learning resources.

To update an existing Bevy App or Plugin to Bevy 0.20, check out our 0.19 to 0.20 Migration Guide.

Since our last release a few months ago we've added a ton of new features, bug fixes, and quality of life tweaks, but here are some of the highlights:

Solari, Bevy's realtime pathtraced renderer, has seen major improvements to pretty much every aspect of the plugin!

Read JMS55's blog for the technical details, or continue reading below for the high level overview.

Thanks to improvements in our ReSTIR implementation, rendering is now mostly unbiased, leading to much more accurate lighting.

Additionally, thanks to some other changes, moving objects no longer have shadows that lag behind, and reflections now look significantly less shimmery in motion, especially for non-metallic materials.

DLSS-RR has gotten very good in recent updates, and for many scenes, ReSTIR costs a decent chunk of performance, and does not significantly improve image quality.

As a result, we've decided to make ReSTIR optional, and turn it off by default.

If you were using Solari in Bevy 0.19, check if the loss of ReSTIR affects your scene, and if so re-enable SolariLighting::restir.

With ReSTIR off, expect reduced shadow quality and missing shadows in motion in scenes with many lights. We are exploring cheaper ways of improving light sampling, without ReSTIR, to improve this in the future.

In addition, Solari's scene management code is now retained (similar to retained render world optimizations in previous versions of Bevy), and overall much more optimized, leading to significantly reduced CPU costs.

You may also want to take a look at the new fields in SolariLighting. While we aim to set reasonable defaults that will work well across a wide variety of games, there are now many knobs (world cache size, per-pixel light sample count, temporal accumulation, and path tracing bounce count) that can be tweaked to improve performance or quality for your specific scene, project and hardware.

Solari now supports lighting from Atmosphere and EnvironmentMapLights on cameras, in addition to the existing support for DirectionalLight and emissive meshes. We're hoping to add support for the remaining PointLight, SpotLight, and RectLight types in the near future.

Solari now also runs on macOS, but note that there is currently no built-in denoiser included in bevy_solari for macOS. MetalFX Ray Reconstruction might be a possible solution in the future (contributions welcome!)

Finally, our dlss_wgpu crate has been updated to support the latest version of DLSS, bringing support for DLSS-RR 4.5, which significantly improves denoising quality in Solari.

If you were using DLSS in Bevy 0.19, make sure to download and setup the newest version of the DLSS SDK, else you will run into compiler errors.

BSN landed with a few idiosyncrasies that caused friction in practice. We made some changes to BSN's syntax this cycle in the interest of improving its ergonomics and clarity. After this, the syntax should largely be nailed down.

All scene references now require @ prefixes:

In addition to making it easier to spot scene inclusions (and unifying the syntax across cases), this freed us up to make component values much easier to work with!

You can now remove all of those pesky template_value wrappers from your component values:

Enums no longer require VariantDefaults or FromTemplate, provided they implement Default and Clone:

If you were using an enum that didn't support VariantDefaults, you can now remove the template_value wrapper:

The removal of VariantDefaults does mean that enums must now have every field specified:

We believe this tradeoff is worth it, as it increases BSN's compatibility with arbitrary Rust enums. Rust doesn't support "enum variant defaults" anyway!

The "builder pattern" (and chained methods generally) previously required a template_value wrapper. This can now be removed:

Additionally, you can now remove the template_value wrapper in cases like this:

In general, you should now be able to remove all template_value instances from your BSN declarations!

BSN previously used commas to separate entities, with optional () around entities to make the boundaries clearer. This resulted in a lot of syntax noise, line noise, and over-indentation:

To avoid this, many developers opted for this syntax instead, which made it very hard to visually distinguish entities:

BSN now uses -- to separate entities in a list:

This gives us the best of all worlds: entities are visually distinct, and there is no over-indentation, line noise, or syntax noise (the stats when compared to other competitors in the "markup format" space are very competitive!). Both () and , have been deprecated in this context.

Using [] and () for bsn_list! (and bsn!) is now discouraged / warned against (ex: bsn_list! []), as it can result in poor rustfmt autoformatting. Instead, use bsn_list! {}, which is the only syntax that rustfmt won't touch. Don't worry, we plan to build a BSN auto-formatter!

We landed BSN, Bevy's next generation scene system, in our last release. It was missing a key piece though: the ability to easily run logic when a scene is fully "ready" and spawned (ex: all dependencies have loaded, the full hierarchy is present, and all of the initial components are inserted in the scene). This is a critical piece for building cohesive, standalone, composable scenes. It is also necessary to properly layer Bevy logic on top of other scene representations (like glTF).

The closest we had was the Add event for a given component, which runs "top down" (meaning children are not available). We needed a "bottom up" equivalent to enable building logic that relies on the complete loaded and spawned scene.

The solution is pretty straightforward: trigger a new Ready event for each entity in a spawned scene after the full spawn logic has run for that entity (including its descendants).

This enables the following:

Feathers, Bevy's opinionated editor-centric UI toolkit, now has more widgets for you to play with:

Bevy now has a compact color input selector that displays a color picker widget popup when clicked. This includes a color wheel selector, RGB, and HSL selectors, and a recently used colors grid.

A scrollable, selectable list view.

A selection field that when clicked, displays a dropdown containing a list of options to select.

The FeathersNumberInput widget has been expanded to support both normal text input and scrubbing / dragging. There is a configurable "hard limit" (minimum and maximum value via any input method) and "soft limit" (minimum and maximum value via dragging), in addition to control over floating point precision and step sizes.

bevy_ui_widgets now has headless (bring-your-own-visuals) tab behavior: a TabList container and Tab headers.

Selection is managed "externally". SelectedTab on the list holds the selected tab; interaction emits ValueChange<Option<Entity>> as a request, applied by the app or by the optional tablist_self_update observer.

Tabs support keyboard shortcuts and integrate with Bevy's focus, interaction, and accessibility systems.

See the headless_tabs example for controlled and self-updating tab lists in both orientations.

Bevy's shaders are now written in WESL and the old "Custom Bevy Extended WGSL" language support has been removed.

WESL is a language standard that extends WGSL to add important usability features like modules, imports, conditional compilation, and more. You can see what that looks like (and render pretty shader toys!) live in your browser in the WESL Playground.

Bevy has historically handled these things in our own custom WGSL dialect, but we believe it is better for the wider shader ecosystem (and for us) to adopt a common standard where we can pool resources on language improvements, module ecosystems, and IDE tooling. We've been working closely with the WESL team to evolve the standard in a way that fits well into the Bevy picture.

A critical part of that tooling is language server protocol support, in the form of wgsl-analyzer. That means syntax highlighting, go-to-definition, inlay hints, code folding, formatting and more, once installed for your IDE of choice.

Custom shaders in the old Bevy WGSL dialect need to be translated to WESL and renamed from .wgsl to .wesl. Plain WGSL files with no preprocessor directives will keep working.

Mesh shaders are now integrated with Bevy's pipeline cache and are available for advanced users to take advantage of. Mesh shaders can be used to render:

Mesh shaders, at a high level, replace the classic vertex shader with a compute shader. This allows generating geometry directly on the GPU and passing those generated primitives directly to the fragment shader without using multiple pipelines or intermediary buffers (to pass data from a compute shader to a render pipeline).

A MeshPipeline contains:

The new MeshPipelineDescriptor can be used to define a MeshPipeline. That MeshPipeline is then used as a RenderPipeline, which allows the re-use of Bevy's lower level rendering APIs such as RenderContext::begin_tracked_render_pass to take advantage of the new draw_mesh_tasks APIs.

It is notable that mesh shaders are an advanced graphics approach with platform-specific performance considerations, and that this is the initial base support for the feature. Higher level user APIs, and easy integration with Bevy's StandardMaterial, are left to future work.

Mesh shaders are not supported on web platforms.

Check out the new mesh_shader_intro example for more usage examples.

Until now, Bevy's sprite renderer has been lacking a major feature: the ability to extend it with custom shaders! With this release, it's now possible to create custom materials for sprites by implementing the MaterialExtension2d trait, inserting the SpriteMaterial component and adding the SpriteMaterialPlugin to your app.

The shader can use functions exported from bevy_sprite_render::sprite_mesh::functions, including:

Check out the sprite_material example to see it in action!

Bevy now provides a 2D analog to 3D's ExtendedMaterial, which can be used to extend an existing material by implementing the MaterialExtension2d trait:

This material can now be used in an ExtendedMaterial2d struct:

The sprite render backend was replaced by a new backend that reuses a lot of the infrastructure made for 3D. This resulted in improved performance in many cases and also makes future maintenance and improvements easier.

We have upstreamed the awesome bevy_editor_cam made by @aevyrie as the new PanOrbitCamera in our bevy_camera_controller crate!

Add MeshPickingPlugin and DefaultPanOrbitCameraPlugins:

Then add the PanOrbitCamera component on any 3D camera.

Full functionality is shown in the camera/pan_orbit_camera_cad example.

Ordering large groups of systems with .chain() is convenient, but it can be overly strict. If system set X is chained before system set Y, every system in X must finish before any system in Y can start, even when the systems involved never touch the same data. This often leaves worker threads idle while they wait for a handful of stragglers at the end of a system set, a pattern that shows up frequently in the render world.

The new chain_weak(), before_weak(), and after_weak() functions provide a looser alternative. Like their regular counterparts, they request an ordering between successive elements, however that ordering is only kept between systems whose data accesses actually conflict. Systems that don't conflict are left unordered and may run in any order, including in parallel.

When two weakly-ordered systems actually conflict on their data access, a normal ordering is kept between them, so the earlier one still runs first. Two systems that conflict only through a non-conflicting system between them in the chain stay ordered as well. Non-conflicting systems, however, are left free to run in any order and overlap for increased parallelism!

Two kinds of system are treated as always conflicting, so their ordering is always kept: an earlier system that produces deferred effects such as Commands (so the later system observes them, with an ApplyDeferred sync point inserted as usual), and exclusive systems (which cannot overlap anything regardless).

Because the scheduler can only see accesses it tracks, dependencies expressed through interior mutability on read-only accesses, global state, or other untracked methods are not respected. Use chain_weak only when your systems don't rely on such hidden ordering, otherwise stick with chain.

Feathers now supports "contextual theming", meaning that the theme variables can change depending on the parent entity. So widgets that are inside of a dialog box or subpanel can have different colors than widgets that are on a regular panel or window background.

The design follows that of popular web toolkits like MUI, Radix, or Chakra. There's a new component, ThemeContext, which lets you select which color scheme the widget's descendants should use; currently the available schemes are Base, Higher, Highest, and Floating, which correspond to the design plans for the Bevy scene editor.

The theme context is used in conjunction with a new kind of design token, named SemanticToken. The lookup process for a color now requires two stages: the ThemeToken is converted into a SemanticToken, and then the combination of SemanticToken and ThemeContext is used to look up a color.

In addition to allowing context-specific color choices, this also makes it easier to design new themes! Instead of having to tediously choose colors for a hundred different theme tokens, the set of semantic tokens is much smaller, and the relationship between token and color is much more intuitive.

Bevy UI now supports em and rem as sizing units. em is the current font size (represented by an EmSize component), rem is a global "root" font size (represented by the existing RemSize resource).

EmSize is derived from TextFont when one is on the same entity; propagating it down the hierarchy is left to your app.

This is especially useful if you might want to vary your text size after authoring your UIs, for example as an accessibility feature or just to improve your UI on different devices.

The default font-size is now rem(1) rather than px(20). This is a no-op if you're not changing RemSize but it means your text will scale by default when you do.

Components can now opt-in to "column summary change ticks":

When enabled, this will store a "column change tick" in addition to a "per-entity change tick", which allows cheaply skipping the whole column of entities when querying for changes, rather than needing to check every entity's component to see if it has changed.

This makes mutations more expensive, as they need to write both the column change tick and the entity change tick, but for entities whose changes are queried often, but change infrequently, this tradeoff can easily be worth it! We've seen change ticks result in a 132x speedup in our GPU mesh extraction code!

FixedNode is a new marker component for Bevy UI.

A UI node entity with the FixedNode component is positioned relative to the target camera's viewport rather than its parent element. FixedNodes don't inherit their parent's layout, clipping or transform context. They behave like a "root node".

Bevy UI can now draw nodes with elliptical border geometry.

The fields of BorderRadius are now CornerRadiuss to enable different radius to be set for each axis.

Before a schedule runs (and therefore, your systems), it first computes the system run order based on their ordering constraints (.before(), .after(), .chain()) and system sets. However, in addition to this, the schedule must also resolve conflicts - if system A and system B both mutate component C, and there's no ordering between A and B, the schedule needs to pick one to run first. So far, the rule has been that this is non-deterministic.

In practice though, schedules pick the order of these conflicting systems "deterministically, but arbitrarily". Put simply, your systems might accidentally be in the right order, but making an unrelated change to the graph might suddenly put it in the wrong order. This problem can be very difficult to detect.

Introducing schedule randomization! This will randomize the order of systems while maintaining any explicit system ordering constraints. Once the debug feature is enabled, ScheduleBuildSettings will include a shuffle_seed field, that users can set to randomize their schedules. For example:

This can be used for "property testing", to verify that your systems satisfy some property despite different orderings of systems.

There are some caveats however. Currently, when using auto_insert_apply_deferred, systems with commands are always placed before the earliest sync point they can. This means that although your systems may not have the correct ordering, they might "accidentally" have the correct ordering because of which sync point it uses. We hope to fix this in the future.

In addition, the multi-threaded executor executes systems greedily: it looks for the first unexecuted system whose dependencies are finished and that has no other conflicting systems running. The result is that even if the shuffle results in the order (A, B, C), C could run before B if A and B conflict. This can be desirable to test, but consider using the single-threaded executor to avoid this case.

感谢 227 位贡献者、817 个拉取请求、社区代码审查者以及我们慷慨的资助者，我们很高兴地宣布 Bevy 0.20 已在 crates.io 正式发布！
对于尚不了解的人来说，Bevy 是一款基于 Rust 构建、清爽简约的数据驱动游戏引擎。您可以查阅我们的《快速入门指南》立即体验。它永远免费且开源！您可以在 GitHub 上获取全部源代码。欢迎查看 Bevy Assets，了解社区开发的插件、游戏和学习资源合辑。
如需将现有的 Bevy 应用程序或插件更新至 Bevy 0.20，请查看我们的《0.19 至 0.20 迁移指南》。
自几个月前发布上一个版本以来，我们添加了大量新功能、错误修复和体验优化调整，以下是其中的一些重点亮点：
Solari 作为 Bevy 的实时路径追踪渲染器，该插件的几乎每个方面都迎来了重大改进！
阅读 JMS55 的博客了解技术细节，或继续阅读下文了解总体概述。
得益于我们对 ReSTIR 实现的改进，渲染现在基本实现了无偏估计（unbiased），从而带来了更为精确的光照。
此外，由于其他一些改动，运动物体的阴影不再出现滞后现象，并且运动中的反射闪烁感也显著降低，特别是对于非金属材质。
DLSS-RR 在最近的更新中表现非常出色，对于许多场景而言，ReSTIR 会占用相当一部分性能，却并未显著改善图像质量。
因此，我们决定将 ReSTIR 改为可选功能，并默认将其关闭。
如果您在 Bevy 0.19 中使用了 Solari，请检查禁用 ReSTIR 是否会对您的场景产生影响；如果需要，可重新启用 SolariLighting::restir。
在关闭 ReSTIR 的情况下，在多光源场景中可能会出现阴影质量下降以及运动物体阴影缺失的情况。我们正在探索在不使用 ReSTIR 的情况下以更低开销改进光照采样的方法，以便在未来改善这一问题。
此外，Solari 的场景管理代码现在改为保留模式（retained）（类似于 Bevy 早期版本中的保留渲染世界优化），并且整体上得到了更深度的优化，从而大幅降低了 CPU 开销。
您可能还想查看 SolariLighting 中的新增字段。虽然我们的目标是设定能够在各种游戏中良好运行的合理默认值，但现在提供了许多调节旋钮（世界缓存大小、每像素光照采样数、时间累积以及路径追踪弹射次数），可以针对您的特定场景、项目和硬件进行微调以提升性能或画质。
除了现有的 DirectionalLight 和自发光网格支持外，Solari 现在还支持来自相机上的 Atmosphere 和 EnvironmentMapLights 光照。我们希望在不久的将来增加对剩余的 PointLight、SpotLight 和 RectLight 类型的支持。
Solari 现在也支持在 macOS 上运行，但请注意，bevy_solari 目前尚未为 macOS 包含内置降噪器。MetalFX Ray Reconstruction 可能是未来的可行解决方案（欢迎贡献代码！）。
最后，我们的 dlss_wgpu crate 已更新以支持最新版本的 DLSS，带来了对 DLSS-RR 4.5 的支持，这极大地改善了 Solari 中的降噪质量。
如果您在 Bevy 0.19 中使用了 DLSS，请确保下载并配置最新版本的 DLSS SDK，否则会遇到编译错误。
BSN 推出时带有若干在实际使用中造成阻碍的特性。为了提高其易用性和清晰度，我们在本周期内对 BSN 的语法进行了若干改动。经过这些调整后，语法应该基本敲定。
所有场景引用现在都需要带有 @ 前缀：
这不仅让识别场景引入变得更加容易（并在各种场景下统一了语法），还让我们能够大幅简化组件值的处理！
您现在可以从组件值中移除所有烦人的 template_value 包装器：
枚举只要实现了 Default 和 Clone，就不再需要 VariantDefaults 或 FromTemplate：
如果您之前使用的枚举不支持 VariantDefaults，现在也可以移除 template_value 包装器：
移除 VariantDefaults 确实意味着枚举现在必须显式指定每一个字段：
我们认为这种权衡是值得的，因为它提高了 BSN 与任意 Rust 枚举的兼容性。反正 Rust 本身也不支持“枚举变体默认值”！
“构建器模式”（以及通常的链式方法）以前需要 template_value 包装器。现在可以将其移除：
此外，在类似以下的情况下，您现在也可以移除 template_value 包装器：
总的来说，您现在应该可以从 BSN 声明中移除所有 template_value 实例！
BSN 以前使用逗号分隔实体，并使用可选的 () 包裹实体以明确边界。这导致了大量的语法噪音、行噪音和过度缩进：
为了避免这种情况，许多开发者选择改用这种语法，但这使得在视觉上极难区分实体：
BSN 现在使用 -- 来分隔列表中的实体：
这让我们兼得两全：实体在视觉上清晰可辨，且没有过度缩进、行噪音或语法噪音（与“标记格式”领域的其他竞品相比，指标非常具有竞争力！）。在此语境下，() 和 , 均已被弃用。
现在不再建议 / 会警告在 bsn_list!（以及 bsn!）中使用 [] 和 ()（例如：bsn_list! []），因为这可能导致较差的 rustfmt 自动格式化效果。相反，请使用 bsn_list! {}，这是 rustfmt 唯一不会改动的语法。别担心，我们计划开发一个 BSN 专用自动格式化工具！
我们在上一个版本中推出了 Bevy 的下一代场景系统 BSN。但它当时缺少一个关键功能：在场景完全“就绪”并生成时（例如：所有依赖均已加载、完整层级结构已就绪，并且所有初始组件都已插入场景中）轻松执行逻辑的能力。这是构建内聚、独立且可组合场景的关键一环。将 Bevy 逻辑正确叠加在其他场景表示（如 glTF）之上也是必不可少的。
我们此前最接近的功能是针对给定组件的 Add 事件，它是“自顶向下”运行的（意味着子实体尚不可用）。我们需要一个“自底向上”的等效机制，以支持构建依赖于完整加载和生成的场景的逻辑。
解决方案非常直接：在为生成的场景中的实体运行完完整的生成逻辑后（包括其子代实体），为该实体触发一个新的 Ready 事件。
这实现了以下能力：
Feathers 作为 Bevy 具有鲜明观点的、以编辑器为中心的 UI 工具包，现在提供了更多组件供您使用：
Bevy 现在拥有一个紧凑的颜色输入选择器，点击时会弹出颜色选择器微件。这包括一个色轮选择器、RGB 和 HSL 选择器，以及常用颜色网格。
一个可滚动的、支持选择的列表视图。
一个选择字段，点击后会显示一个包含可选选项列表的下拉菜单。

FeathersNumberInput 部件现已扩展，同时支持常规文本输入以及滑动/拖拽操作。除控制浮点精度和步长之外，还提供了可配置的“硬性限制”（通过任何输入方式允许的最小值和最大值）和“软性限制”（通过拖拽允许的最小值和最大值）。

bevy_ui_widgets 现在具备了无头（自备视觉样式）标签页行为：包含一个 TabList 容器和 Tab 头部。

选中状态在“外部”进行管理。列表上的 SelectedTab 保存当前选中的标签页；交互会发出 ValueChange 作为请求，由应用程序或可选的 tablist_self_update 观察者应用。

标签页支持键盘快捷键，并与 Bevy 的焦点、交互和无障碍系统相集成。

有关受控和自更新标签页列表在两种方向上的实现，请参阅 headless_tabs 示例。

Bevy 的着色器现已改用 WESL 编写，原有的“自定义 Bevy 扩展 WGSL”语言支持已被移除。

WESL 是一项语言标准，它通过扩展 WGSL 添加了诸如模块、导入、条件编译等重要的易用性功能。你可以在 WESL Playground 中直接在浏览器中实时查看其效果（并渲染漂亮的着色器小玩具！）。

Bevy 历来在我们自己的自定义 WGSL 方言中处理这些特性，但我们认为，采用一个通用标准对更广泛的着色器生态系统（以及对我们自身）都更有利，这样我们就可以在语言改进、模块生态和 IDE 工具链上汇聚资源。我们一直与 WESL 团队密切合作，以契合 Bevy 蓝图的方式推进该标准的发展。

该工具链的一个关键组成部分是以 wgsl-analyzer 形式提供的语言服务器协议（LSP）支持。这意味着只要在所选 IDE 中安装它，就能获得语法高亮、跳转到定义、内联提示、代码折叠、格式化等功能。

使用旧版 Bevy WGSL 方言编写的自定义着色器需要转换为 WESL，并将文件后缀从 .wgsl 重命名为 .wesl。不含预处理器指令的纯 WGSL 文件将继续正常工作。

网格着色器（Mesh Shaders）现已集成到 Bevy 的管线缓存中，可供高级用户利用。网格着色器可用于渲染：

从高层次来看，网格着色器用计算着色器取代了经典的顶点着色器。这允许直接在 GPU 上生成几何体，并将生成的图元直接传递给片段着色器，而无需使用多个管线或中间缓冲区（用于将数据从计算着色器传递到渲染管线）。

MeshPipeline 包含：

可以使用新的 MeshPipelineDescriptor 来定义 MeshPipeline。然后将该 MeshPipeline 用作 RenderPipeline，从而允许复用 Bevy 的底层渲染 API（例如 RenderContext::begin_tracked_render_pass）来利用新的 draw_mesh_tasks API。

值得注意的是，网格着色器是一种高级图形学方案，伴随着特定平台的性能考量，目前这只是该特性的初步基础支持。更高级的用户 API 以及与 Bevy 的 StandardMaterial 的简易集成留待后续开发。

网格着色器在 Web 平台上不受支持。

有关更多用法示例，请查看新的 mesh_shader_intro 示例。

在此之前，Bevy 的精灵（sprite）渲染器一直缺少一项主要功能：使用自定义着色器进行扩展的能力！在此版本中，现在可以通过实现 MaterialExtension2d 特征（trait）、插入 SpriteMaterial 组件并将 SpriteMaterialPlugin 添加到应用中，来为精灵创建自定义材质。

着色器可以使用从 bevy_sprite_render::sprite_mesh::functions 导出的函数，包括：

查看 sprite_material 示例即可亲身体验！

Bevy 现在为 3D 的 ExtendedMaterial 提供了 2D 对应版本，可通过实现 MaterialExtension2d 特征来扩展现有材质：

该材质现在可用于 ExtendedMaterial2d 结构体中：

精灵渲染后端已被替换为一个复用了大量 3D 基础设施的新后端。这在许多情况下提升了性能，也使未来的维护和改进变得更加容易。

我们已经将由 @aevyrie 开发的优秀 bevy_editor_cam 合并进上游，作为 bevy_camera_controller crate 中的全新 PanOrbitCamera！

添加 MeshPickingPlugin 和 DefaultPanOrbitCameraPlugins：

然后在任何 3D 相机上添加 PanOrbitCamera 组件。

完整功能展示在 camera/pan_orbit_camera_cad 示例中。

使用 .chain() 对大型系统组进行排序很方便，但可能过于严格。如果系统集 X 链式排在系统集 Y 之前，那么 X 中的每个系统都必须运行完毕，Y 中的任何系统才能开始，即便涉及的系统根本没有触及相同的数据。这往往会导致工作线程处于空闲状态，等待系统集末尾的少数落后者，这种模式在渲染领域中经常出现。

新的 chain_weak()、before_weak() 和 after_weak() 函数提供了一种更宽松的替代方案。与常规对应函数一样，它们请求相连元素之间的执行顺序，但该顺序仅在数据访问实际发生冲突的系统之间保留。不冲突的系统则不作顺序约束，可以按任意顺序运行，包括并行运行。

当两个弱排序系统的数据访问实际发生冲突时，它们之间会保持常规顺序，因此排在前面的系统仍会先运行。两个仅通过链中处于它们之间的非冲突系统而产生冲突的系统也会保持有序。然而，非冲突系统可以自由地以任意顺序运行并重叠执行，从而提高并行度！

有两类系统被视为始终冲突，因此它们的顺序始终保持：产生延迟效果（如 Commands）的靠前系统（以便靠后系统能观察到它们，并照常插入 ApplyDeferred 同步点），以及排他性系统（exclusive systems，无论如何都不能与任何系统重叠）。

因为调度器只能感知其追踪的访问，所以通过只读访问上的内部可变性、全局状态或其他未追踪方式表达的依赖关系将不会被遵循。仅在系统不依赖此类隐式顺序时才使用 chain_weak，否则请继续使用 chain。

Feathers 现在支持“上下文主题化”，这意味着主题变量可以根据父实体而改变。因此，位于对话框或子面板内的部件可以拥有与常规面板或窗口背景上的部件不同的颜色。

该设计遵循了 MUI、Radix 或 Chakra 等流行 Web 工具包的风格。有一个新的组件 ThemeContext，可供选择部件的子代应使用哪种配色方案；目前可用的方案有 Base、Higher、Highest 和 Floating，分别对应 Bevy 场景编辑器的设计规划。

主题上下文（theme context）与一种名为 SemanticToken 的新型设计令牌结合使用。颜色的查找流程现在分为两个阶段：ThemeToken 首先被转换为 SemanticToken，随后结合使用 SemanticToken 与 ThemeContext 来查找颜色。
除了允许针对特定上下文进行颜色选择之外，这也使得设计新主题变得更加容易！用户不再需要繁琐地为上百个不同的主题令牌单独挑选颜色，语义令牌的集合要小得多，而且令牌与颜色之间的关系也直观得多。
Bevy UI 现在支持将 em 和 rem 作为尺寸单位。em 代表当前字体大小（由 EmSize 组件表示），rem 代表全局“根”字体大小（由现有的 RemSize 资源表示）。
当同一实体上存在 TextFont 时，EmSize 会从中派生；将其沿层级向下传递则由你的应用程序决定。
如果你希望在构建好 UI 后调整文本大小，这会特别有用，例如用于实现无障碍功能，或者仅仅为了改善 UI 在不同设备上的呈现效果。
默认字体大小现已改为 rem(1)，而非 px(20)。如果你不修改 RemSize，这不会产生任何影响；但这意味着当你修改它时，文本将在默认情况下按比例缩放。
组件现在可以选择启用“列摘要变更刻（column summary change ticks）”：
启用后，除了“每个实体的变更刻”外，系统还会存储一个“列变更刻”。这允许在查询变更时以较低开销跳过整列实体，而无需检查每个实体的组件以确定其是否发生了变更。
这使得变更操作（mutation）的开销更高，因为它们需要同时写入列变更刻和实体变更刻；但对于那些变更查询频繁但实际变更并不频繁的实体而言，这种权衡是完全值得的！我们已经看到变更刻在 GPU 网格提取代码中带来了 132 倍的加速！
FixedNode 是 Bevy UI 的一个新标记组件。
带有 FixedNode 组件的 UI 节点实体是相对于目标相机的视口进行定位的，而不是相对于其父元素。FixedNodes 不继承父级的布局、裁剪或变换上下文。它们的行为类似于“根节点”。
Bevy UI 现在可以绘制带有椭圆边框几何形状的节点。
BorderRadius 的字段现在改为了 CornerRadiuss，以便能够为每个轴设置不同的半径。
在调度器运行（并随之运行你的系统）之前，它首先会根据系统的顺序约束（.before()、.after()、.chain()）和系统集（system sets）计算系统的运行顺序。然而除此之外，调度器还必须解决冲突——如果系统 A 和系统 B 都修改组件 C，且 A 和 B 之间没有明确的顺序，调度器就需要挑选一个先运行。到目前为止，这一规则一直是非确定性的（non-deterministic）。
但在实践中，调度器对这些冲突系统所选择的顺序往往是“确定性但随意的”。简而言之，你的系统可能碰巧处于正确的顺序，但对图进行一次毫不相关的修改可能会突然使其处于错误的顺序。这种问题可能非常难以察觉。
隆重推出调度随机化（schedule randomization）！这将在保持任何显式系统顺序约束的同时，将系统的运行顺序随机化。一旦启用了调试特性，ScheduleBuildSettings 将包含一个 shuffle_seed 字段，用户可以设置该字段来将其调度随机化。例如：
这可用于“基于属性的测试（property testing）”，以验证系统即便处于不同的执行顺序下，是否依然满足某些属性。
不过也有一些注意事项。目前，当使用 auto_insert_apply_deferred 时，包含命令（commands）的系统总是会被放置在它们所能使用的最早同步点之前。这意味着即使你的系统可能没有正确的顺序，它们也可能由于其使用的同步点而“碰巧”具备正确的顺序。我们希望在未来修复这一问题。
此外，多线程执行器会贪婪地执行系统：它会寻找第一个尚未执行、依赖项已完成且没有其他冲突系统正在运行的系统。其结果是，即使洗牌后的顺序是 (A, B, C)，如果 A 和 B 发生冲突，C 仍可能会在 B 之前运行。这在测试中可能正是所期望的，但也可以考虑使用单线程执行器来避免这种情况。
该工具是互补的

trendStories.fullContent:
Peter Fonagy lauds courage of young people and warns of consequences of rising prevalence of mental illness

Full report | NHS at risk of ‘system failures’ as demand for ADHD and autism care soars, inquiry finds

Explainer | What has the Fonagy review found and what does it recommend?

Eighteen months ago, in an off-the-cuff remark during a discussion on disability benefit cuts, Wes Streeting said mental health conditions were being “overdiagnosed”, riding headlong into another culture war.

He later apologised for the comment, but at the time it seemed the then health secretary had endorsed a populist view that ordinary stresses and disappointments had become too often medicalised, resulting in a surge of bogus clinical diagnoses and creating a “snowflake generation” of fragile, avoidant and workshy young people.

I am in awe of their courage. Young people are contending with more powerful forces than I ever faced
trendStories.fullTranslation:
彼得·福纳吉（Peter Fonagy）赞扬年轻人的勇气，并对精神疾病患病率上升的后果发出警告
完整报告 | 调查发现，随着ADHD和自闭症照护需求激增，英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）面临“系统性崩溃”风险
深度解读 | 福纳吉审查报告有哪些发现及建议？
18个月前，在关于削减残障津贴的一次讨论中，韦斯·斯特里廷（Wes Streeting）随口表示心理健康状况正被“过度诊断”，一头扎进了又一场文化战争。
他随后为该言论道歉，但在当时，这位时任卫生大臣似乎认可了一种民粹主义观点，即普通压力和挫折被过于频繁地医学化，导致虚假临床诊断激增，并造就了由脆弱、逃避和厌工的年轻人构成的“雪花一代”。
“我对他们的勇气深感敬佩。年轻人正在与比我以往所面对的更为强大的力量进行抗争。”

trendStories.fullContent:
Prof Peter Fonagy’s 607-page report is categoric that mental distress has increased substantially and ‘cannot be explained by greater awareness alone’

Full report | NHS at risk of ‘system failures’ as demand for ADHD and autism care soars, inquiry finds

Analysis | No ‘snowflakes’: mental health review says today’s youth have it harder and harms are real

The Fonagy review of NHS England’s mental health, ADHD and autism services was commissioned in 2025 by Wes Streeting, then the health secretary, in response to growing concerns that spiralling waiting lists for assessment, diagnosis and care threatened the NHS’s ability to meet the demand.

The 607-page report, published on Friday , says that without a radical overhaul, mental health and neurodiversity services will be overwhelmed. Here are some of its key findings and recommendations.
trendStories.fullTranslation:
彼得·福纳吉教授（Prof Peter Fonagy）长达607页的报告明确指出，心理困扰已大幅增加，且“不能仅仅用认知度提高来解释”。
完整报告 | 调查发现，随着对多动症（ADHD）和自闭症照护需求激增，国民保健署（NHS）面临“系统性崩溃”风险
深度分析 | 绝非“脆弱一代（snowflakes）”：心理健康审查称当今年轻人处境更艰难，所受伤害真实存在
针对英格兰国民保健署心理健康、多动症及自闭症服务的福纳吉审查，是由时任卫生大臣韦斯·斯特里廷（Wes Streeting）于2025年委托开展的，旨在回应各界日益加剧的担忧——即不断攀升的评估、诊断和照护等待名单已威胁到国民保健署满足需求的能力。
这份于周五发布的607页报告指出，如果不进行彻底改革，心理健康和神经多样性服务将被彻底压垮。以下是该报告的部分核心发现与建议。

trendStories.fullContent:
England-focused mental health review returns stark warning and calls for shift to ‘needs-led’ system

Explainer | What has the Fonagy review found and what does it recommend?

Analysis | No ‘snowflakes’: mental health review says today’s youth have it harder and harms are real

The NHS in England is heading into a “world of system failures” as it struggles to cope with relentlessly rising demand for mental health, ADHD and autism care, leaving those affected desperate for support, a government-commissioned inquiry has found.

The stark warning was made in a review led by Prof Peter Fonagy into the sharp rise in demand over recent decades for help with mental health and neurodevelopmental conditions.
trendStories.fullTranslation:
一项聚焦英格兰的心理健康审查发出了严厉警告，并呼吁转向“以需求为导向”的体系。

解读 | 福纳吉审查发现了什么，又提出了哪些建议？

分析 | 绝非“玻璃心”：心理健康审查指出当代青年处境更艰难，伤害真实存在

一项由政府委托的调查发现，英格兰国民保健署（NHS）正陷入一个“系统性崩溃的境地”，原因是其难以应对对心理健康、注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）以及自闭症诊疗服务持续激增的需求，导致受影响人群迫切需要支持却求助无门。

这一严厉警告出自彼得·福纳吉教授（Prof Peter Fonagy）牵头的一项审查，该审查针对近几十年来对心理健康和神经发育障碍救助需求的急剧上升展开了深入调查。

trendStories.title: 64天证书有效期将于2027年2月生效
trendStories.fullContent:
We will switch to issuing 64 day certificates in our staging environment on October 14, 2026 to enable testing. We recommend testing in staging before the change takes effect in production.

If your renewals are automated and your client supports ACME Renewal Info (ARI), you should be all set since ARI allows Let’s Encrypt to tell your client when to renew (you can review your ACME client’s documentation to determine if ARI is implemented).

If your renewals are hard-coded to a date from expiration you should update them to renew at approximately ⅔ of the lifetime instead. Taking this step in preparation for 64 day lifetimes will lay the groundwork for default lifetimes of 45 days in 2028. Grep for common hardcoded numbers like 83, 80 or 60 in cron jobs, wrapper scripts and runbooks if you’re not sure.

We will also be reducing the authorization reuse period from 30 days to 10 days. In 2028, the reuse period will shrink to seven hours. We are making this change to comply with a 2029 reduction in maximum validation reuse periods, and to remove the need for “CAA rechecking”, where we have to repeat part of the validation process if the validation data is more than 7 hours old. Unless you have specifically designed your ACME client to rely on validation reuse, you will not need to make any changes.

This is also an opportunity to automate certificate management processes like reload and deployment and to add alerting for renewal failures.

Rate limits will not be impacted by this change; you can learn more in our previous blog post.

This change will not affect ACME endpoints or our issuance chains.

We are moving to shorter certificate lifetimes because this reduces the risk of key compromise and mis-issuance. As a nonprofit we see it as part of our mission to make this change to advance security for everyone using the Web globally. We anticipate a smooth transition, but if you experience issues, our community forum and documentation are good resources.

ISRG is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that is 100% supported through the generosity of those who share our vision for ubiquitous, open Internet security. If you'd like to support our work, please consider getting involved, donating, or encouraging your company to become a sponsor.

我们将在2026年10月14日开始在测试环境（staging environment）中签发64天有效期的证书以供测试。我们建议在该变更正式进入生产环境前，先在测试环境中进行验证。

如果您的证书续期已实现自动化，且客户端支持 ACME 续订信息（ARI），您便无需担忧，因为 ARI 允许 Let’s Encrypt 告知您的客户端何时应当续期（您可以查阅 ACME 客户端文档以确认是否已支持 ARI）。

如果您的续期时间是根据距离到期日的固定天数硬编码设置的，您应将其调整为在有效期的约 ⅔ 时进行续期。为 64 天有效期采取这一准备措施，将为 2028 年将默认有效期缩短至 45 天打下基础。如果您不确定，可以在定时任务（cron jobs）、封装脚本和操作手册中通过 grep 查找常见的硬编码数字，如 83、80 或 60。

我们还将把授权复用期（authorization reuse period）从 30 天缩短至 10 天。到 2028 年，复用期将进一步缩短至 7 小时。我们做出这一改变是为了遵守 2029 年对最长验证复用期的缩减要求，并消除对“CAA 重新检查”（CAA rechecking）的需求——即如果验证数据超过 7 小时，我们必须重复部分验证流程。除非您专门设计了 ACME 客户端依赖验证复用，否则您无需进行任何调整。

这也是将重新加载和部署等证书管理流程自动化、并为续期失败添加报警通知的绝佳契机。

速率限制（Rate limits）不会受到此变更的影响；您可以在我们先前的博客文章中了解更多信息。

此变更不会影响 ACME 端点或我们的签发链。

我们转向更短的证书有效期，是因为这能降低私钥泄露和错误签发的风险。作为一家非营利组织，我们认为推行这一举措以提升全球 Web 用户的安全性是我们的使命所在。我们预计此次过渡将平稳进行，但如果您遇到任何问题，我们的社区论坛和官方文档是很好的支持资源。

ISRG 是一家 501(c)(3) 非营利组织，完全依靠与我们抱有相同愿景——致力于实现普遍、开放的互联网安全——的各方人士的慷慨支持。如果您想支持我们的工作，请考虑参与其中、进行捐赠或鼓励您的公司成为赞助商。

trendStories.originalTitle: Navier-Stokes lost in translation: Why Lean verification of AI autoformalisation does not guarantee correct natural language proofs

trendStories.fullContent: Autoformalisation is increasingly used to verify mathematical texts, including those generated by AI, as in OpenAI's announced proof of blow-up of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations. In this process, an AI system translates the text from a natural language (NL) into a formal language such as Lean. Once this translation is done, the argument expressed in the formal language can easily be mechanically verified. The purpose of this article is to demonstrate why this process may offer no confidence in the original NL argument, owing to the various difficulties in performing the translation semantically faithfully. In particular, we highlight that the problem of resolving ambiguities in mathematical NL text, which is necessary in order to provide semantically faithful translation, is arbitrarily high up in the Solvability Complexity Index (SCI) hierarchy/arithmetical hierarchy (the SCI = ∞). Hence, informally, providing semantically faithful AI autoformalisation is harder than any computational problem including the Halting problem (which has SCI = 1). To demonstrate the effect of this result we provide several examples of AI mistranslations of NL statements and proofs into Lean in practice, resulting in mismatches between NL proofs and their Lean "verifications". These include OpenAI's announced Navier-Stokes proof. In particular, we show that the formalised Lean proof does not correspond to the NL proof of blow-up of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations.
trendStories.fullTranslation: 自动形式化（Autoformalisation）正日益被用于验证数学文本，包括人工智能生成的文本，正如 OpenAI 宣称的纳维-斯托克斯方程解的爆破解（blow-up）证明中所展示的那样。在这一过程中，AI 系统将文本从自然语言（NL）翻译为诸如 Lean 之类的形式化语言。一旦完成这种翻译，以形式化语言表达的论证便能轻松实现机械化验证。本文的主旨在于阐明，由于在进行语义忠实翻译时存在诸多困难，这一过程可能完全无法为最初的自然语言论证提供置信度保证。特别是，我们着重指出，要实现语义保真的翻译，必须解决数学自然语言文本中的歧义问题，而该问题在可解性复杂度指数（Solvability Complexity Index, SCI）谱系/算术谱系中处于任意高的层级（SCI = ∞）。因此，通俗来说，提供语义保真的 AI 自动形式化比包括停机问题（其 SCI = 1）在内的任何计算问题都要困难。为了展示这一结果的影响，我们在实践中列举了若干 AI 将自然语言陈述及证明错误翻译为 Lean 语言的实例，这些错误导致了自然语言证明与其 Lean“验证”之间的脱节。其中包括 OpenAI 宣布的纳维-斯托克斯证明。特别是，我们展示了形式化后的 Lean 证明与纳维-斯托克斯方程解爆破的自然语言证明并不相符。
